title: Zesty Norwegian Mozzarella Pasta
description: A citrusy, shaggy pasta that feels like comfort food, infused with shio-koji salt and fresh mozzarella for a quick sick-day Norwegian twist.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the spaghetti 8-10 minutes until al dente, then drain, reserving a cup of pasta water.
While the pasta cooks, heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and sauté minced garlic until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add the reserved pasta water, lemon juice, orange juice, shio-koji, and black pepper to the skillet; stir to create a glossy citrus sauce.
Return the drained spaghetti to the skillet, tossing it in the sauce until well coated.
Remove the skillet from heat and fold in the cubed mozzarella, grated parmesan, chopped dill, and spinach, stirring until the cheese melts slightly and the spinach wilts.
Taste the pasta and adjust seasoning with extra pepper if desired, remembering the low-sodium shio-koji.
Divide the pasta into two bowls, ensuring each gets an equal share.
Serve hot, optionally garnishing with additional fresh dill or a squeeze of lemon.
